skill.name: edit-article
skill.description: Edit and improve articles by restructuring sections, improving clarity, and tightening prose. Use when user wants to edit, revise, or improve an article draft.
skill.summary: Improve article structure, section order, clarity, and paragraph flow.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only skill file. Manual review found article editing instructions only, with no prompt injection attempt or data exfiltration intent.

content.user_title: Edit Articles for Clarity and Structure
content.value_statement: Long article drafts can lose structure, sequence, and clarity. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through section review and concise revision.
actual_capabilities: Divides an article draft into sections based on headings.
Reviews the main point of each section before editing.
Checks section order against information dependencies.
Asks the user to confirm the section plan before rewriting.
Rewrites each section for clarity, coherence, and flow.
Keeps rewritten paragraphs within a 240 character limit.
limitations: It does not fact check claims or verify external sources.
It does not create a full article from a blank topic.
It depends on visible headings for the initial section map.
It asks for user confirmation before section-level rewriting.

use_cases.title: Refine a Technical Article
use_cases.description: Improve a draft that explains software concepts, while preserving its sequence of ideas.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Blog Draft
use_cases.description: Turn a rough blog post into clearer sections with shorter, easier paragraphs.

use_cases.title: Improve Documentation Narrative
use_cases.description: Restructure a long documentation article so prerequisites appear before dependent details.

prompt_templates.title: Edit a Short Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple article revision.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the edit-article skill on this draft. Start by mapping the sections, then ask me to confirm before rewriting.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Section Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this article for section order and dependencies. Suggest the section plan first, then revise each confirmed section for clarity.

prompt_templates.title: Tighten Paragraphs
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this article so each paragraph is clear, coherent, and under 240 characters. Preserve the core argument and technical accuracy.

prompt_templates.title: Restructure a Complex Article
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a dependency-aware edit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the edit-article workflow to this long draft. Identify dependency order, propose section changes, wait for approval, then rewrite section by section.

output_examples.input: A draft has background details after advanced recommendations.
output_examples.output: The skill proposes moving background sections earlier, asks for confirmation, then rewrites each section in concise paragraphs.

output_examples.input: A blog post has long paragraphs and unclear transitions.
output_examples.output: The skill preserves the article message while shortening paragraphs, improving transitions, and making the section order easier to follow.

output_examples.input: A technical article mixes prerequisites, examples, and conclusions.
output_examples.output: The skill separates prerequisites from examples, checks the dependency order, and rewrites confirmed sections for clearer progression.

best_practices: Provide the full draft with headings before asking for edits.
Review and confirm the proposed section map before rewriting starts.
State any required voice, audience, or terminology constraints upfront.
anti_patterns: Do not use it as a substitute for source verification.
Do not skip the section confirmation step on complex drafts.
Do not expect it to preserve every sentence verbatim.

faq.question: What does this skill edit?
faq.answer: It edits article drafts by improving section order, paragraph clarity, coherence, and flow.

faq.question: Does it ask before rewriting?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow asks the user to confirm the section plan before section rewrites begin.

faq.question: Can it handle technical writing?
faq.answer: Yes. It is useful for technical articles when the draft already includes content and headings.

faq.question: Does it fact check sources?
faq.answer: No. It improves structure and prose, but it does not verify claims or external references.

faq.question: What tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the article draft, headings, audience, style constraints, and any sections that must remain unchanged.
